Prevention: Cover fruit with brown paper bags at least 2 weeks before harvesting (note: only to be done on small tree varieties).
Clear and destroy fallen fruits from the ground outside the field continually throughout the growing season (collect fruit and leave in the sun to kill the maggots).
Hoe the ground underneath the mango tree canopy to expose young insects to sunlight and predators.
Late varieties are more susceptible to attack than early varieties.
Monitoring: Hot weather conditions are favourable for fruitfly development.
